mission_check.capability: Gather varied, real battle decisions and cartridge outcomes for a transferable attack policy
mission_check.learned_authority: Frozen battle ranker remains bounded development-only; no new player authority or fit
mission_check.transfer_test: Compare train episodes with separately reserved upstream development roots and different party/opponent contexts, not timing copies of one state
mission_check.cheapest_falsifier: Authenticated natural captures or unclaimed source roots cannot furnish four distinct choice-rich examples from each of four train roots without a new collection mechanism
mission_check.time_box: One action-free inventory session, at most two hours
mission_check.stop_condition: Stop the static-capture sampling route on insufficient per-root supply; no root claim, replay, model fit, promotion, full run or GitHub publication

authenticated_source_bank.note: Read-only loaded-state inspection; party readiness does not prove an executable or informative battle capture

natural_battle_capture_bank.ordinary_train_fit_gate: At least four roots and four examples per root; existing natural capture bank has zero roots meeting four examples
natural_battle_capture_bank.note: Train capture manifests and state bytes were authenticated and observed; development captures were inventoried by manifests only. No controller input or outcome collection occurred.

remaining_source_supply.note: Account-claim availability alone is insufficient: three available train roots and one available validation root already have historical battle materializations and were excluded. Party slots are potential contrasts, not independent roots or completed examples.

existing_model_comparator.interpretation: Neither comparison establishes an advantage over a simple fixed rule; the assisted pilot is too small and the older evaluation is from historical training-control contexts

decision.reason: The current natural capture bank has no four-example train root, and the small untouched source remainder is concentrated in two goal families. Repeating near-duplicate or assisted captures would not repair the demonstrated coverage and baseline problem.
decision.next_capability: Implement a bounded, model-directed multi-encounter training episode: retain each model-selected pre-decision state and actual outcome, then obtain comparable candidate outcomes only from isolated train-side branches of those states. Reserve separate upstream development episodes and require superiority to both frozen and fixed-heuristic controls before promotion.
decision.next_cheapest_falsifier: ROM-free test of durable choice-before-input, root/partition inheritance, distinct semantic decision counting, hard stops and no teacher fallback; then one precommitted train-only mechanical pilot if it passes
